body:
I obtained this chem from the Netherlands but it had been on my to do list for a while. 300mg taken orally induced some nausea and gave a slight mood boost. I weighed out approximately 9x 300mg capsules and then decided to snort the last 300mg in the baggie.
Snorting brought on effects fast and heavy, a balanced serotonin/dopamine euphoria and severe jaw clenching. Phoned a friend and was putting real effort into prolonging the conversation. I find this chem superior to 3-mmc as the tendency to cross over into paranoia seems not to occur with this drug. Overall a very nice experience, a bit of an MDMA lite.
